high_level_description: The image is a humorous meme that uses a bell curve to illustrate different approaches to product development and launch strategies. The background is orange, which adds a vibrant and energetic feel to the image. At the top of the image, there is a cartoon character with glasses and a distressed expression. This character is labeled with the text: "DO A SURVEY, RAISE MONEY, BUILD TEAM, SPEC PERFECT PRODUCT, HIRE PR FIRM, ETC..." This suggests a detailed and thorough approach to launching a product, which is often associated with high intelligence or high IQ scores.
